name: Akashic solver
plain: Marked experimental in its own print. A sigma-space Adams-Bashforth step inspired by SA-Solver with a tau-controlled noise, plus phase schedules for tau, eta and noise, a SMEA factor and a Native Detail Boost option. It is not the core sa_solver algorithm.
math: τ_t=compute_tau_eqvae(p,τ,phase). η_t by piecewise p. s_eff=s·η_t·smea(p)·phase multiplier. sa_solver_step: dt=σ′−σ, r=min(|dt/h_prev|,2), AB combination of d history up to order, noise via τ. Optional combat_cfg_drift on x0.

claims.text: Prints that EQ-VAE models should use external rescaleCFG around 0.7
